zh-CN.title: 回声唱片铺更新专辑目录
items: 两期奖池均改为收录八位歌手的正式录音室专辑，并重新划分金、铂、钻、曜。
已有的聊天唱片和空间首解奖章仍可查看。

en.title: Echo Record Shop album update
items: Both editions now feature studio albums from all eight artists, with updated Gold, Platinum, Diamond, and Obsidian tiers.
Previously shared chat discs and space-first medals are still available.
